title: 第1371章 林炎的复仇第1370章 损失惨重
content_zh:
“哈哈哈！洪河星行，这就是你们跟那小畜生站在一块的后果！为了林炎，你们要搭上一位无上天才！”
王涛得意狂笑。
上官月俏脸苍白，可纵然她是本源道体，也无力抵抗，只能眼睁睁看着那一击落下。
“敢伤我的女人，你找死！”
可就在这时，一道低沉蕴含震怒的声音蓦然响彻，整个藏宝库之中的所有修士都有一种如同凛冽寒冬的错觉。
咔嚓！
紧接着，一道黑暗长矛横空刺来，直接戳在了那金色大手之上，硬生生将那铭刻了无数神纹的金色大手崩碎了。
“林炎？”
上官月微愣，只见原本正在闭关蜕变中的林炎，竟然睁开了眼睛。此刻的林炎，身体依旧被不死之体的气息侵蚀着，如同遭受剧毒侵蚀，可是那双眼睛，却充斥着撕天的怒意。
“主人！”
鸿钧也是大惊，他看得出来，林炎还没能彻底完成蜕变，是为了救上官月，强行压制那股蜕变的力量。这也太狠了！炼化不死之体的时候强行中断，这是怎样的意志啊！
“小畜生，你好胆，突破的时候居然还敢强行出手！”
俞陀也看出了林炎的状态，不由心头一寒，他是真的被林炎的手段震慑到了！之前他只是听说林炎如何了得，根本没有亲自接触过，当时只觉得是夸大其词，而今一看，林炎比上官月还要可怕百倍不止，绝对是一位盖世神人！
“林炎，郑涛和南宫刚他们俩被杀了！”
上官月声音颤抖，带着一丝哭腔。
“我会为他们报仇的！今日，此地，所有人，都别想走了！”
林炎牙齿咬得嘎吱作响，震怒如同天雷滚滚！这次他是真的怒了！圣殿和焚天宗居然趁他闭关偷袭，如果不是自己冥神体太过霸道，能压制不死之体的本源，只怕上官月等人都得死！而郑涛和南宫刚，更是为了掩护上官月牺牲！这触动了林炎的底线，他决定大清洗，今日血流成河！
“大言不惭的小子，你还没看清楚你现在所处的局势呢！还想杀我们，真是可笑！”
海神圣地的圣子王波讥讽，此地可是有两位圣君中期的强者要杀林炎呢！林炎这边，也就只有鸿钧一个苦苦支撑，怎么抗？就算不提圣殿的冰元，单单只是俞陀，也是圣君四重之中的强者，比鸿钧还要强悍一截！林炎，只是个元海境八重而已，双方的差距已经不能用天壤之别来形容了！
“俞陀长老，杀了他！等会炼化他精血，弥补我们的损失！”

焚天宗的王涛森然道，他迫不及待要饮林炎之血！
“呵呵！敢在老夫跟前咋咋呼呼，看老夫一巴掌拍死你！”
俞陀冷哼一声，再次运转无尽的符文之力，凝聚成一只霸道的金色大手，猛地拍下，那大手足有百丈，几乎挤满了这地下世界的天穹，这一巴掌拍下，仿佛可拍碎整个宇宙。
“开！”
林炎双腿盘坐，没有要起身的意思，他一只手握着暗天矛，冥神体之力催动，幽冥之气森森而动，笼罩在暗天矛之上，使得暗天矛爆发出了前所未有的气息。
这一刻，整个地下世界内，所有生灵全部发怵：“我，我怎么有种神魂崩溃的感觉？！这是元海境修士能发出的一击？”
哪怕是俞陀和冰元这两大巨头，也都有种发自灵魂的骇然之意，仿佛在他们跟前的，不是一个羸弱青年，而是一位执掌一界的神明！即便是元海境四重的修为，也都没能给他们带来丝毫活命的信心！
content_en:
"Hahaha! Honghe Xingxing, this is the consequence of standing with that little beast! For Lin Yan, you have to hook up with a supreme genius!"
Wang Tao laughed wildly with pride.
Shangguan Yue's pretty face was pale, but even though she was the original Taoist body, she was unable to resist and could only watch the blow fall.
"If you dare to hurt my woman, you are seeking death!"
But at this moment, a low and angry voice suddenly sounded, and all the monks in the entire treasure house had the illusion that it was like a biting winter.
Click!
Immediately afterwards, a dark spear pierced through the air, directly piercing the golden hand, and forcefully shattered the golden hand engraved with countless divine patterns.
"Lin Yan?"
Shangguan Yue was stunned for a moment when she saw Lin Yan, who was undergoing transformation in seclusion, actually opened his eyes. At this moment, Lin Yan's body was still being corroded by the aura of the immortal body, as if he was being corroded by poison, but his eyes were filled with heaven-piercing rage.
"Master!"
Hongjun was also shocked. He could see that Lin Yan had not completely completed his transformation, so he wanted to save Shangguan Yue and forcibly suppress the power of transformation. This is too cruel! What kind of will is this to forcibly interrupt the process of refining the immortal body?
"You little beast, you are so brave. You actually dare to take action when you break through!"
Yu Tuo also saw Lin Yan's state, and couldn't help but feel a chill in his heart. He was really shocked by Lin Yan's methods! Before, he had only heard about how great Lin Yan was and had never had any personal contact with him. At that time, he thought it was an exaggeration. But now, he saw that Lin Yan was more than a hundred times more terrifying than Shangguan Yue. He was definitely a peerless god!
"Lin Yan, Zheng Tao and Nangong Gang were killed!"
Shangguan Yue's voice was trembling, with a hint of crying.
"I will avenge them! No one can leave today, here!"
Lin Yan gritted his teeth and his anger was like thunder! This time he was really angry! The Holy Temple and Burning Heaven Sect actually took advantage of his seclusion to attack him. If his Hades body wasn't too domineering and could suppress the origin of the immortal body, Shangguan Yue and others would have died! And Zheng Tao and Nangong Gang sacrificed their lives to protect Shangguan Yue! This touched Lin Yan's bottom line, he decided to clean up, and today there was a river of blood!
"You bratty brat, you haven't seen clearly the situation you're in now! It's ridiculous that you still want to kill us!"
Wang Bo, the Holy Son of the Holy Land of the Sea, sneered, "There are two strong men in the middle stage of the Saint King here who want to kill Lin Yan!" On Lin Yan's side, Hongjun was the only one struggling to support him. How could he resist? Even if you don't mention the ice element of the temple, Yu Tuo alone is also a strong person among the fourth level of the Saint King, even more powerful than Hongjun! Lin Yan was only at the eighth level of Yuan Hai Realm, and the gap between the two sides could no longer be described as a world of difference!
"Elder Yu Tuo, kill him! Later, we will refine his essence and blood to make up for our losses!"
Wang Tao of the Burning Heaven Sect said solemnly, he couldn't wait to drink Lin Yan's blood!
"Haha! If you dare to say anything like that in front of me, I will slap you to death!"
Yu Tuo snorted coldly, and once again used the endless power of runes to condense into a domineering golden hand. He slapped it hard. The big hand was a hundred feet long and almost filled the sky of the underground world. This slap seemed to shatter the entire universe.
"Open!"
Lin Yan sat with his legs crossed and had no intention of getting up. He held the Dark Sky Spear in one hand and activated it with the power of the Hades body. The Nether Qi moved thickly and enveloped the Dark Sky Spear, causing the Dark Sky Spear to emit an unprecedented aura.
At this moment, all the creatures in the entire underground world were in fear: "Why do I feel like my soul is collapsing?! Is this a blow that a Yuanhai realm monk can deliver?"
Even the two giants Yu Tuo and Bing Yuan had a sense of horror coming from their souls, as if the person in front of them was not a frail young man, but a god who was in charge of a world! Even Yuan HaiEven the cultivation of the fourth level could not give them the slightest confidence to survive!
